title: Olfactory stimuli and moonwalker SEZ neurons can drive backward locomotion in Drosophila.
quote: Activation of MDNs using both the broad and narrow MDN driver lines indeed elicited sustained backward walking, as previously observed18 (Figure S2A).
mapping_basis: Paper names the neurons MDNs (moonwalker descending neurons); MDN is a MANC type name in type_list.csv.
stimulation: 470 nm blue light, ~35 mW/cm2, 2 s pulse
sensory_condition: open arena (60 mm), IR illumination, groups of 3-15 females and males
penetrance: ~95% of flies covered >=3 mm backward during the 2-s pulse (Fig. 2H bar)
notes: Paper calls VT50660-GAL4 the 'broad MDN driver line'; other labelled cells not named. Walking measured by centroid tracking (Ctrax) translational velocity, no leg tracking.

title: Two Brain Pathways Initiate Distinct Forward Walking Programs in Drosophila.
quote: SS01540 activation elicited forward walking with a strong turning component whereas SS01587 activation induced straight forward walking
mapping_basis: Paper identifies SS01540 neuron as DNp09 ('henceforth referred to as P9'); kit lists DNp09 as ambiguous (MANC DNp09 and hemibrain name of DNp71) and SS01540 as AMBIGUOUS DNp09;DNp71; paper's anatomy (pair of ipsilateral DNs, outputs SEZ + ipsilateral leg neuropils, Namiki 2018 DNp09) supports DNp09.
stimulation: transient: 630 nm ~4.5 mW/cm2, 50 Hz 5 ms pulses, 30 s ON (grooming) or 10 s ON (copulation); screen: continuous white light 0.5 mW/cm2, 7 min
sensory_condition: bowl-shaped agarose arena; dust-powdered grooming flies, copulating females, and clean flies (screen)
other_cell_types: a few additional unnamed neurons (incl. mushroom body gamma-lobe expression noted in Methods)
coordination_notes: walking initiated from non-walking (grooming/copulation) state; strong turning component
penetrance: 'reliably initiated walking' in powdered flies; screen hit (>5-fold walking increase powdered, >1.2-fold clean)
n_flies_note: n=16-24 (grooming assay, Fig. 1C), 9-11 (copulation, Fig. 1D), 12-16 per condition (screen, Fig. 1B)
notes: Centroid tracking (FlyTracker); no leg tracking during activation. Figures/supplement not available locally; coded from text and legends.

title: Two Brain Pathways Initiate Distinct Forward Walking Programs in Drosophila.
quote: SS01540 activation elicited forward walking with a strong turning component whereas SS01587 activation induced straight forward walking
mapping_basis: Paper says SS01587 'labels DN0p28 and 7 other neuronal types' (DN0p28 is not a kit name; likely typo); kit maps SS01587 to DNp29 (Namiki 2018), conflicting with the paper's 'p28'. Coded DNp29 via driver line, low confidence.
stimulation: transient: 630 nm ~4.5 mW/cm2, 50 Hz 5 ms pulses, 30 s ON (grooming) or 10 s ON (copulation); screen: continuous white light 0.5 mW/cm2
sensory_condition: bowl-shaped arena; powdered grooming flies, copulating females, clean flies
other_cell_types: BPN (Bolt protocerebral neurons, ~8 cells/hemisphere, non-DN; paper attributes walking to BPN)
coordination_notes: straight forward walking, no turning bias
notes: Mosaic analysis (Fig. S5B) attributes the walking to BPNs, a non-DN higher-brain type also labelled by this line; the DN in this line is therefore probably not causal. Name/line mapping conflict (DN0p28 vs kit DNp29).
